summary: This tutorial covers various view options in LibreOffice Writer, specifically for documents on a GNU/Linux system with version 334 of the software. It explains how to switch between print layout and web layout views. Print layout shows how a document will look when printed, while web layout displays it as it would appear in a web browser, useful for creating HTML documents. Full screen mode can be accessed through the view menu or by clicking specific options. Zoom features allow adjusting the display size for better editing and viewing. The tutorial also discusses the view layout dialog box, which includes options like fit width and height, fit to width, and custom zoom factors. These settings help in efficiently viewing and editing different pages of a document. Additionally, it mentions the view layout icons on the status bar, which control the document's view layout and zoom.
